feature: Add a conflicts_with parameter to click.Option (and click.option) accepting a sequence of other option names or flags that conflict with this option.
policy_a: Combining conflicting options on the command line raises a usage error (exit code 2) whose message names both conflicting options.
policy_b: When conflicting options are combined on the command line, the option that appears last on the command line wins with no error.
reason_a: Automated scripts should fail loudly when given contradictory flags instead of silently guessing which one the caller meant.
reason_b: Shell wrappers and aliases often pre-populate default flags, so letting the last flag on the command line override an earlier conflicting flag is ergonomic.
